captions.detailed: A miniature Newtonian reflector telescope mounted on a motorized equatorial mount. It features a main optical tube assembly colored in off-white with black trim rings, a black prismatic rack-and-pinion focuser, and a small finder scope. The tube is clamped via a black dovetail saddle to a multi-axis black equatorial mount, which sits on a simple three-legged black tripod base. The mount features a continuous right-ascension axis and a revolute declination axis for tracking celestial objects.
captions.instruction: Generate a Newtonian reflector telescope on a motorized equatorial mount. The model should include a white cylindrical main tube with black end rings, a detailed black rack-and-pinion focuser with a finder scope, a black dovetail clamping saddle, and an equatorial mount with dual rotational axes resting on a three-legged tripod stand.
captions.factory: Construct the telescope using a series of parts and rotational joints. Build the tripod base by combining three rectangular box legs around a central vertical cylinder. Create the polar axis housing using angled boxes and cylinders, then attach a continuous right-ascension joint to a declination axis assembly. Model the main optical tube as a large cylinder with thin end-ring cylinders, and construct the rack-and-pinion focuser using nested box and cylinder primitives. Finally, attach the optical tube assembly to the mount's saddle via a revolute declination joint.
